newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Transener wins power concession.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Transener wins power concession.

text.p: Argentina's Transener SA has won a concession to operate Buenos Aires province's energy transmission company Eseba with a $220 million bid, the government of Argentina's most populous province said Friday.
The provincial Public Works Ministry said in a statement that Eseba, which operates 3,400 miles (5,500 km) of energy transmission lines, would now operate as TRANSBA SA.
The contract for the 95-year concession is to be signed on July 22 and control transfered to Transener on August 1.
- $132.5 million offered by the Litba consortium, made up of Argentine companies Sideco Americana, Cartellone, Pirelli and Codi.
- $167 million offered by Camuzzi of Italy.
- $176 million offered by U.S. firm AES and CEA Americas.
